name: Vulturine Parrot
rangeDescription: Humid forest of eastern amazonian brazil south of the amazon
description: Medium-sized, largely green parrot with a striking head pattern. The head is featherless with a combination of orange, black, and yellow bristles.

name: Alor Myzomela
rangeDescription: Alor (lesser sundas)
description: A striking and little-known small honeyeater found only in the eucalyptus-dominated highlands of Alor, in the eastern Lesser Sundas. Unmistakable in its limited range; note bright red face and crown (brighter and more extensive in the male), pale belly, gray back, red rump, and slightly curved dark bill.

name: Nonggang Babbler
rangeDescription: Limestone hills of southwestern guangxi (southeastern china), and in adjacent extreme northeastern vietnam (eastern tonkin)
description: A medium-sized brown babbler with pale eyes and a lopsided white crescent bordering the back half of the cheek. Short-tailed and large-headed in profile.

name: Christmas Island White-eye
rangeDescription: Christmas island (eastern indian ocean); introduced cocos (keeling) island
description: One of only a handful of resident tree-dwelling songbirds on Christmas Island, and the only white-eye. Tiny warbler-like bird with an olive-yellow crown and back, soft gray underparts, and a slightly broken white eye-ring.

name: Altai Accentor
rangeDescription: Mountains of central asia to afghanistan, southern tibet, and northwestern india
description: Gray-brown overall with orange streaks on the breast and a white throat bordered by a thin black outline. Similar to Alpine Accentor, but darker and more extensively streaked.

name: Pallid Spinetail
rangeDescription: Mountains of southeastern brazil (brasília to espírito santo and southeastern são paulo)
description: Small, acrobatic spinetail found in the canopy of montane forests; especially fond of epiphytes. Usually accompanies mixed-species flocks.

name: Cinnamon-faced Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Andean foothills of central and southeastern peru and adjacent northern bolivia
description: Small yellowish tyrannulet with a narrow reddish facial patch. Usually perches horizontally in the mid-story and canopy of humid montane forest.

name: River Lapwing
rangeDescription: Rivers of india and nepal to southwestern china and indochina
description: The black, gray, and brown coloration of this medium-sized shorebird makes it unmistakable. Raises black crest when displaying.

name: Bronze-winged Parrot
rangeDescription: Humid forest of northeastern colombia to western venezuela and northwestern peru
description: A medium-sized parrot that usually looks all dark. With a good view, note the deep bluish-purple color overall with bronzy wings, messy pink splotches on the upper breast, and red undertail coverts.

name: White-fronted Chat
rangeDescription: Southern australia including tasmania, and king and flinders islands
description: A small bird patterned in black, white, and gray. Adult males have white underparts and face contrasting with an obvious black neck-band which extends around from the back of the head.

name: Riverside Wren
rangeDescription: Pacific lowlands of southwestern costa rica and far western panama
description: Medium-sized wren with rufous upperparts and bold black-and-white barred underparts. Complex black-and-white face pattern.

name: Black-faced Spoonbill
rangeDescription: Breeds northeastern china and korea; winters to southeastern asia
description: Large white waterbird with a long spatula-shaped bill. Breeding adults have long plumes on the head and a smudging of yellow on the chest.

name: McKay's Bunting
rangeDescription: Islands in bering sea; winters to coastal alaska and aleutian islands
description: Rare white snowball shrouded in mystery. Nonbreeding birds have buffy fringes to head and back feathers that wear to white by spring.

name: Rufous-sided Scrub-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Southern suriname and eastern brazil to northeastern bolivia and northeastern paraguay
description: Tiny flycatcher with a long tail. Note the white throat contrasting with the brown back, yellowish belly, and cinnamon flanks.

name: Inca Dove
rangeDescription: Semiarid southwestern usa to northwestern costa rica
description: Essentially a ground dove with a long tail. Pale sandy color with scaly pattern covering entire body, unlike Common Ground Dove.

name: Wrenthrush
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: A strange little understory bird, unmistakable if seen well. Plump and very short-tailed, like a small antpitta or wren.

name: Zarudny's Sparrow
rangeDescription: Desert of south-central asia (uzbekistan and turkmenistan)
description: Small, delicate pallid sparrow. Both sexes have pale gray upperparts, a black bib, black lines in front of the eyes (lores), sandy underparts, and large white wing patches.

name: Rusty-tinged Antpitta
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of northern peru (amazonas to eastern la libertad)
description: Medium-sized antpitta restricted to cloud forest along the east slope of the Andes in northern Peru. Adult is rich cinnamon brown with a white belly and throat (sometimes tinged yellow), a gray crown, and a bluish eye-ring.

name: Chatham Islands Oystercatcher
rangeDescription: Chatham islands (chatham, mangere, rangatira, and pitt)
description: Stocky wader with distinctive pied plumage, red eye surrounded by orange eye-ring, orange bill, and pink legs and feet in adults. Juvenile birds have paler skin and dark tip to bill.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Slender-billed Babbler
rangeDescription: Grassland of nepal to assam and northwestern myanmar
description: Distinctive chestnut-brown babbler with a slightly decurved bill and a pale throat. Shy and difficult to see in its well-vegetated habitat; favors wet grassy or reedy areas.
